title: StrataCorporation
description: The legal entity, made up of the owners of the strata lots, that is responsible for managing and maintaining the common property and common assets of a strata plan.
x-validationRules: name should match the legal name on title, including the strata plan number.
strataPlanNumber must equal the planNumber of the referenced StrataPlan when strataPlanId is present.
A corporation with status "dissolved" should not be the target of new governance or financial records.
x-legalReviewNotes: Confirm wording of the definition against the Strata Property Act before marking stable.
Confirm whether "windingUp" is a useful distinct status for data exchange.

id.description: Stable identifier of this StrataCorporation record.

name.description: Legal name, typically in the form "The Owners, Strata Plan EPS1234".

commonName.description: Informal or marketing name of the development, if any.

strataPlanNumber.description: Number of the strata plan that created this corporation.

strataPlanId.description: The strata plan record for this corporation.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction whose legislation governs the corporation.

x-enumDescriptions.active: The corporation exists and is operating.
x-enumDescriptions.windingUp: A winding-up process has been started.

establishedDate.description: Date the corporation came into existence (normally the date the strata plan was deposited).

fiscalYearEnd.description: Last day of the fiscal year as MM-DD.

managementOrganizationId.description: Strata management company currently engaged, if any.

extensions.description: Implementation-specific data, namespaced by reverse domain.
